name: sheepfold
description: Your coding-agent sessions from spacesheep, in a VS Code sidebar, the ones that need you first.

viewsWelcome.contents:

sheepfold.cli.description: The spacesheep CLI to run. A bare name is looked up on PATH; use an absolute path when VS Code does not inherit your shell's PATH. A leading ~/ is expanded.

sheepfold.refreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh the list while the view is visible. While it is hidden the list still refreshes, at most once a minute, for the badge and the nudges.

sheepfold.hideDoneAfterHours.description: Hide finished sessions older than this many hours. 0 shows them all.

sheepfold.localMachines.description: Machine names to treat as this machine, besides the host name (a trailing .local is ignored).

sheepfold.mirrorUrl.description: Base URL of the local spacesheep mirror, used to open sessions from other machines.

sheepfold.resume.description: Offer to resume sessions from other folders (a new window) or other machines (Remote-SSH). Off: a click only navigates — Claude Code for a session in this workspace, spacesheep for every other — and nothing is opened or written elsewhere.

sheepfold.remoteSessionPath.description: Path appended to the mirror URL for "Show on spacesheep". Placeholders: {source}, {id}, {machine} (URL-encoded). The default opens the session's own page.

sheepfold.remoteOpenIn.description: Where a remote session opens: VS Code's Simple Browser, or your default browser.

sheepfold.showEmpty.description: Show sessions that never got a prompt (no turns, no title, or a transcript with no user message). They have nothing to open.

sheepfold.claudeConfigDir.description: Claude Code's config directory, where session transcripts live (<dir>/projects/*/<id>.jsonl). Empty: the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR entry of the Claude Code setting claudeCode.environmentVariables, else the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, else ~/.claude.

sheepfold.remotes.description: How to reach other machines over SSH, keyed by the machine name the session list shows. Example: { "server": { "sshHost": "server", "home": "/home/me" } }. sshHost is a Remote-SSH host; home is that machine's home directory, which a leading ~ in a session's folder expands to.

sshHost.description: Host as Remote-SSH names it (an ~/.ssh/config alias or user@host).

home.description: Absolute home directory on that machine.

sheepfold.inactivePerGroup.description: Idle and finished sessions shown per project (and per dispatched node); sessions needing you or working are always shown. Click "N more…" to show the rest. 0 shows none until expanded.

sheepfold.dispatchedTitlePattern.description: Regular expression for titles of non-interactive (dispatched) sessions, such as "repo: topic · host". A session whose transcript says it ran through the SDK CLI is dispatched whatever its title. Empty turns the title test off.

sheepfold.nudges.description: Show a status-bar nudge for 15 seconds when a session starts needing you or finishes. A click goes to it.

scripts.check: tsc -p . && node --test out/test/*.test.js && node scripts/render_icon.js && vsce package --no-dependencies

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Sheepfold runs the spacesheep CLI named in its settings.
